credits.title: 11 Rebels
credits.overview: When the brutal Boshin War breaks out in Japan, a group of inmates on death row unite to defend a fortress against the Imperial army.

credits.title: Living in Two Worlds
credits.overview: Dai grows up in a small town, interpreting for his loving deaf parents, until he moves to Tokyo in search of his own independent life.

credits.title: The Moon
credits.overview: Yoko, who gets a job at a nursing home, witnesses the elderly and disabled people there having their human dignity threatened.

credits.title: Small, Slow But Steady
credits.overview: Keiko surprises everyone when she overcomes adversity to win her first two boxing fights. But when an unexpected incident threatens the closure of her gym, she is pushed further than she thought possible.

credits.title: Until Rainbow Dawn
credits.overview: When Hana falls in love with Ayumi, a girl she meets in her sign language group, she comes out to her parents who swiftly reject her.
